banned_content: graphic or distressing imagery without context

rules.attribute_every_claim: Every factual claim in a caption must be traceable to the cited source.
rules.no_invented_numbers: Never invent statistics, dates, casualty figures, or quotes. If the source does not give a number, do not supply one.
rules.no_misleading_visuals: Images must illustrate the story honestly. Do not use a photo or graphic that implies an event, vessel, or location it does not show.
rules.respectful_tone: Crew welfare and casualty stories are handled with respect. No sensational language, no speculation about causes before an official finding.
rules.separate_fact_from_commentary: Facts come from the source; any commentary or interpretation must be clearly labelled as such and must not be presented as fact.
